description:
Aggressive build order to try and overwhelm the opponent with a strong push in Feudal Age.
Block enemy production with shinobis' sabotage abilty and win by simply outnumbering the opponent.

Other japanese builds:
- FC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/vEngvoom6xbHijnpEYRl
- 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/BKgxe5CAXfcRTj4Sbq5C
name: Japanese | Feudal all-in
author: Jockxtar

notes: We need to chop 2 entire @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ before building a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
@unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ role will be to use sabotage on enemy production buildings, nothing more. Once they do that, retreat them to safety.

Upgrade and produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to counter their cavalry. Keep a few protecting your @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@, move the rest to help in the all-in.
6 @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ is enough to constantly sabotage up to 3 production buildings. But, because they might die during fights, it's best to have at least 9.
Prioritize @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ over @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@, as they are more useful at both killing @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ and ranged units.

While you mass a decently sized army, focus on blocking resources such as @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/resource_stone.webp@, and sabotage production buildings with @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@.

To do this, move the @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ first to tank the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ shots, then move the @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to force enemy ranged units away or get some @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ kills. Last, move the @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ to use the sabotage skill.
Don't fully dive the enemy @building_economy/town-center.webp@ too soon or you will not be able to reach critical mass.
When you start to gather from @resource/deer.webp@ and @resource/boar.webp@, research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@
@building_economy/town-center.webp@ cancel all @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on queue and research @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@

@technology_japanese/tatara-1.webp@+@technology_japanese/hizukuri-2.webp@+@unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@ aura allows @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to reach killing breakpoints on @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ even if they have @technology_economy/textiles.webp@ (6 hits with it, 4 hits without it). This makes them really strong raiders.

Once the @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@ reaches the @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ army, it's the perfect moment to go for the dive. Focus production buildings first, then @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and then additional @building_economy/town-center.webp@ before going for the main @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
With excess @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build a second @building_military/stable.webp@ and a second @building_military/barracks.webp@
If you see an angle to finish the opponent, research @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ and build 2 @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@.

You can put @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ inside @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@ to protect them against @building_economy/town-center.webp@ fire while waiting for a new round of sabotages on the enemy production.
If you can't quite finish off the opponent and end up with a high bank of @resource/resource_gold.webp@, stop producing units for a bit and age up @age/age_3.webp@
@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ to boost production further and research veteran upgrade for @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ quicker.
Research veteran upgrade for @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ and @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@, @technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@ and @technology_japanese/kobuse-gitae-3.webp@
That's all you should need to close the game by simply torching down enemy landmarks.
